lines.zh: 我摆着尾巴，在水草间穿过去。
lines.en: I swish my tail through the water weeds.

lines.zh: 水底的黏土软软的，蹭着肚子。
lines.en: The clay bed is soft against my belly.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流漂，不用自己游。
lines.en: I let the current carry me.
Light ahead — glow berries.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤过去，鳍擦了一下。
lines.en: I squeeze through a gap; a fin scrapes.
Blowing bubbles, I float upward.

lines.zh: 洞顶垂着藤，我从中间穿过。
lines.en: Vines hang from the roof; I swim between them.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，好看清每块石头。
lines.en: I swim slowly to read every stone.
The water is cool — perfect.
I hug the cave floor, hunting for food.
My four little feet paddle hard.

lines.zh: 上面的水面在晃，我看见了。
lines.en: The surface ripples above; I see it.
I round that stalactite.
Where it's slick, I'm steadiest.

lines.zh: 我在繁茂洞穴的浅水里转圈。
lines.en: I circle through the shallow water of the lush cave

lines.zh: 我停下来，等一只蝌蚪过去。
lines.en: I pause and let a tadpole pass

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等小鱼自己过来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open, waiting for a fish.

lines.zh: 水里的声音闷闷的，很好听。
lines.en: Sound underwater is muffled and lovely.
I rub my face against the clay.
That glow berry sways and sways.

lines.zh: 我把自己盘起来，像一圈粉色。
lines.en: I coil up like a pink ring.

lines.zh: 洞里的水滴声一下、一下。
lines.en: Drips fall in the cave, one, then one more.
I forget what I was about to do.

lines.zh: 有只蝌蚪从我旁边游过。
lines.en: A tadpole swims past me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像小扇子一样张开。
lines.en: My gills fan out like little fans.

lines.zh: 我尝了尝水，今天味道不一样。
lines.en: I taste the water; today it's different.

lines.zh: 光从洞口照进来，一条一条的。
lines.en: Light enters the cave in stripes.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，看着它升上去。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it rise.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的东西。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something that won't come.

lines.zh: 这样泡着，一天就过去了。
lines.en: Soaking like this, a whole day slips by.

lines.zh: 你把脸贴近水面，我看见你了。
lines.en: You put your face to the water; I see you.
Your reflection sways above my head.
Coming in? The water's lovely.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，总是滴水。
lines.en: I know your boots; they always drip.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就游过去蹭一下。
lines.en: Reach in, and I'll swim over to nudge you.

lines.zh: 你的脸好大，比我整个身子都大。
lines.en: Your face is huge — bigger than all of me.

lines.zh: 别敲石头，声音在水里太响。
lines.en: Don't tap the stone; it rings too loud underwater.
You smell of dry earth.
I circle your hand three times.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁也不动。
lines.en: We look at each other, neither moving.
I sink straight to the bottom.
A corner of my fin is torn.
The water's clouded; I can't see.
Who's hitting me underwater?

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，游得歪歪的。
lines.en: I flip over and swim crooked.
I hide in a clay hollow.
Bubbles burst out of me at random.

lines.zh: 我缩起鳍，装成一块石头。
lines.en: I fold my gills and play stone.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打到水面上了。
lines.en: That knocked me up to the surface.
I flick my tail and dive deeper.
Is that bucket of water for me?

lines.zh: 我看见一条热带鱼，别拿走。
lines.en: I see a tropical fish — don't take it.

lines.zh: 你把桶放低，我就自己进去。
lines.en: Lower the bucket and I'll climb in.

lines.zh: 水花溅出来了，我闻到家的味。
lines.en: Water splashes out; I smell home.

lines.zh: 那条鱼在动，我的头跟着动。
lines.en: The fish wriggles; my head follows.

lines.zh: 你要把我带去哪儿？先说好有水。
lines.en: Where are you taking me? Promise water.

lines.zh: 桶里太挤了，但我忍一忍。
lines.en: It's cramped in the bucket, but I'll manage.
I peek over the rim to see how deep it is.

lines.zh: 鱼的味道顺着水飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of fish drifts through the water.
That one in your hand — may I have it?
My nose bumped the stone.
Sorry — I was swimming too fast.

lines.zh: 你踩到水底，扬起一片泥。
lines.en: You stepped on the bottom and stirred up mud.
I slip past your leg.
Two bumps and all the bubbles scatter.
Don't flick me; I get dizzy.
I crashed into the water weeds.

lines.zh: 你的桶碰到洞壁，声音好大。
lines.en: Your bucket knocked the cave wall — so loud.
I back off a little; you go first.
The water's too cloudy to see the way.

lines.zh: 我们对着游，鳍几乎碰上。
lines.en: We swim toward each other, gills almost touching.
You're pink too — how nice.
That fish is for you; I've eaten.
We float side by side at the surface.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，尾巴扫起细沙。
lines.en: I circle you, my tail sweeping fine sand.
There are only the two of us in this cave.
You swim steadier than I do.

lines.zh: 等小的出来，会是什么颜色？
lines.en: When the little ones come, what color will they be?
Don't go far; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 我碰了碰你的鳍，你懂了。
lines.en: I touched your gills; you understood.
I've got this fish in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在头上，像顶帽子。
lines.en: I balance it on my head like a hat.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，我都能找到。
lines.en: Anything dropped in water, I can find.
Carrying it, I can barely swim.

lines.zh: 这枚石头亮亮的，我收着。
lines.en: This stone glitters; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我把它推进黏土里藏好。
lines.en: I push it into the clay to hide it.
Mouth full — can't say a word.
I spit it out and it sinks.
Wrong taste — not food.
I carry them back one at a time.
The water stirs; something swims.
That fish has its back to me.
A squid is behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我看见一只蝌蚪落单了。
lines.en: A tadpole has strayed from the rest.
That shadow on the surface isn't mine.

lines.zh: 有东西在啃水草，声音很脆。
lines.en: Something's nibbling the weeds — crisp little sounds.
Those weeds keep trembling.
My gills are standing up.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，我在它上方。
lines.en: It hasn't seen me; I'm above it.
I edge closer, tail still.
It ducks into a crevice; I follow.
I'm just a little faster than it.
It hit the cave wall — perfect.
I circle it until it's dizzy.

lines.zh: 水面上的光挡了我的眼。
lines.en: The light on the surface blinds me a little.
Almost within reach of my jaws.
It's fleeing toward the clay.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞底追，泥都起来了。
lines.en: I chase along the floor, kicking up mud.
It stopped — playing dead.
One more bite and it's done.
I clamp my jaws on its tail.
My teeth aren't sharp, but my grip is.
I whip my head and fling it away.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我咬住就不松口。
lines.en: Don't touch me; once I bite, I don't let go.
Water splashes all around my head.
I lunge and pin it down.
It's bigger than me, and I still don't back off.
I bite empty water; my teeth click.
That one tore its fin.
Done, I shake my head and swim off.

lines.zh: 我在黏土上醒来，四周全是水。
lines.en: I wake on the clay, water all around.
The berries on the cave roof are glowing.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，看见的是绿色。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was green.

lines.zh: 我下面五格，全是软软的黏土。
lines.en: Five blocks down, all soft clay.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾巴，水动了。
lines.en: I flick my tail and the water moves.

lines.zh: 这片水潭安静得只有滴答声。
lines.en: This pool is so still I hear only dripping.

lines.zh: 我是这窝里最小的那只。
lines.en: I'm the smallest of this brood.
I rise and take a breath of air.

lines.zh: 洞口太窄，我绕了两圈才出去。
lines.en: The opening's narrow; two laps to get out.

lines.zh: 有同伴在石头后面看着我。
lines.en: One of my kind watches from behind a stone.

lines.zh: 水在发烫，我拼命往下沉。
lines.en: The water's scalding; I dive as deep as I can.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，落在石头上。
lines.en: Flung out of the water, I land on stone.
Out of water, I can't catch my breath.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我撞在洞壁上。
lines.en: The water bursts; I slam into the cave wall.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水，扎进我的尾巴。
lines.en: An arrow cut the water and struck my tail.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾散开，我的鳍发麻。
lines.en: Violet mist spreads; my gills go numb.

lines.zh: 水里的鱼都躲起来了，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: The fish have all hidden; I'm starving.

lines.zh: 雷声透过水传下来，闷得吓人。
lines.en: Thunder comes through the water, muffled and awful.
No water left; I fall into nothing.
